SACHIN PATIL CONTACT DETAILS Email: imsachinpatil17@gmail.com Phone: +91 9096359275

CAREER SUMMARY

Highly motivated and results-driven professional with 4 years of total experience and 3 years of experience in SAP EWM in implementation & support consulting projects. Proficient in business processes and SAP EWM operations to provide effective solutions. Seeking a challenging position as SAP EWM functional Consultant to drive successful project implementations

SKILLS & EXPERTISE

EWM Organization Structure Physical Inventory JIRA & Service Now Inbound & Outbound delivery process Post processing framework HU Management Storage Types WPT Creation & determination Wave Management WT Creation & WOCR Packaging Specifications RFC Connections Putaway & Stock removal strategies Value Added Services (VAS) Cross Docking POSC & LOSC Cutover Activities Adhoc Movements EWM-PP Integration EWM-QM Integration Packaging Specifications

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

| Designation: Senior Executive | Role: SAP EWM Junior Consultant |

| Wipro Consumer Care & Lighting | April 2023 – Present |

 Managed end to end configuration of inbound and outbound delivery processes including goods receipt, Putaway strategies,

Performed configurations for EWM warehouse structure, ensuring seamless integration as per client’s requirement.

 

 





goods issue, picking, packing and shipping. Set up of RFC connections and enhancements in RF device screens as per requirements of resources. Set up storage type control POSC and storage bin creation as per client requirement to optimize warehouse performance. Implemented Putaway strategies like FIFO, LIFO along with bulk storage type and pallet storage type to streamline warehouse operations. Configured and optimized Cross docking process ensuring compliance with client-specific requirements. Supported in design and implementation of physical inventory process, including cycle counting and periodic inventory. Configured Warehouse Process Types (WPT) and determined appropriate warehouse task (WT) and warehouse order creation rules (WOCR) to automate warehouse operations. Performed configurations for Handling units and cutover activities. Performed and supported configurations of wave management to group and process outbound deliveries efficiently based on delivery date, product type, location etc. Proficient in configuring and set up of Packaging Specifications, warehouse process type determination, warehouse order creation rules (WOCR) and replenishment.

Gained extensive knowledge on Data migration, EWM-QM Integration, EWM-PP Integration and cross module integration

with SAP MM, SD etc.

| Designation: Senior Executive | Role: SAP Support Consultant |

| Wipro Consumer Care & Lighting | April 2022 – April 2023



Collaborate with end users to understand their issues. Collaborate with internal stakeholders and consultants from different SAP domains to resolve complex issues.

Resolved tickets on Inbound and outbound processes, warehouse tasks, batch management, storage bins, warehouse orders and provide solutions etc.

Public

 Regularly update ticket status in JIRA, ensuring all open tasks are addressed as per SLA.  Maintained an internal document for the commonly occurring issues along with their solutions for faster resolution to



improve productivity and efficiency. Produced weekly reports on number of tickets assigned, their statuses, and resolution timelines. Presented these reports to client and internal team members.

|Designation: Internship|Wipro Consumer Care & Lighting|Aug 2021 – Feb 2022

Managed Purchase and sales order processing, ensuring accurate data entry and timely fulfillment of vendor & customer requirements. Collaborated with logistics teams to schedule deliveries, track shipments, and resolve delivery related issues promptly.

 Assisted in pricing & quotation updates and maintained records within the SAP ERP system.  Developed and maintained documentation for standard operating procedures related to sales and distribution processes.    Generated weekly and monthly reports to provide insights about inventory levels.  Collaborated with cross-functional teams to streamline processes and enhance operational efficiency.

| Designation: Production Planning & Control Engineer | Anusaya Auto Press Parts Pvt. Ltd. | | May 2018 - October 2018

Responsible for managing production and assembly line for Mahindra tractor components.  Managed a team of 30 team members to carry day-to-day activities. 

Plan & develop production schedules based on demand forecasts, ensuring optimal resource allocation and minimizing lead times.

Analyzed production data to identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements, leading to a 8% increase in



overall efficiency. Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including procurement and quality assurance, to ensure timely availability of materials and compliance with production standards.

Monitored inventory levels and implemented inventory control measures, reducing excess stock by 12% while maintaining adequate supply for production needs. Participated in regular production meetings to discuss progress, challenges, and strategies for continuous improvement.

 Monitored inventory levels reducing excess stock by 15%  Utilized SAP ERP systems for data tracking and analysis, contributing to improved data accuracy.

ACADEMICS

| Masters in Business Administration | Savitribai Phule Pune University | Specialization - Marketing & Operations (2019- 2021) | CGPA - 8.24 |

| Bachelor of Engineering | KBC North Maharashtra University | Specialization - Mechanical (2013-2017) | | CGPA - 7.59 |

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION



Certifications: 1) Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (Coursera)

2) Lean Six Sigma White Belt Certification (Management & Strategy Institute, USA.



Community Initiatives: 1) Campaign Volunteer for BrandM Advertising Pvt. Ltd. 2) Participated in Marathon for farmers by Rotaract Club.

Public
